integrations.name: Render deploy
integrations.note: This app: https://bolibench-demo-1b3o.onrender.com (free plan, Singapore), auto-deployed from master, with token-gated live mode on. One hosted live run (cancel-single-order) passed in 35 s on 2026-10-18; live history is kept in memory, so that run is no longer listed after a redeploy. The earlier read-only service is suspended and no longer used.

integrations.name: Gemma 4 via the Gemini API (OpenAI-compatible backend)
integrations.note: Exercised by this deployed app through its token-gated live run: the example agent calls gemma-4-31b-it on Google's Gemini API through its OpenAI-compatible backend (native tool calls, reasoning_effort minimal); one deployed run so far (cancel-single-order, pass, logs only). Separately, one unseeded full-suite run from a laptop on 2026-10-18 gave 8 pass / 3 fail / 1 error (the error: the 180 s turn deadline missed through provider latency, after correct tool calls); not bundled here. The same backend also ran locally against Ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1 with qwen3:8b (2 of 2 cases pass). Not DigitalOcean.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs speech
integrations.note: Real ElevenLabs API, called from a laptop on 2026-10-18; not part of the deployed app. Free tier, eleven_multilingual_v2 TTS + scribe_v2 STT: TTS, STT, the opt-in live test, the CLI with the audio cache (rerun reused the audio), and 3 cases end to end with local qwen3:8b acting on the transcripts (1 pass / 2 fail; the text-only run of the same cases: 0 / 3). Synthetic voice, n=1 per case: shows the pipeline works, not speech robustness.

integrations.name: Backboard bridge
integrations.note: Partial: the chosen paid model is blocked by billing. Real API on 2026-10-18, from a laptop: auth, model list, assistant/thread and the tool-call round trip work (two bridge bugs found live and fixed); memory isolation between cases checked. The chosen open-weight model (qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507) could not run: the account's free credit does not pay for LLM chat. A zero-priced preview model passed 3 of 4 cases. No full-suite run, and not two models. Not part of the deployed app.

integrations.name: Gemma via Ollama
integrations.note: gemma3:4b full suite run locally: 2 pass / 10 fail, JSON tool mode (no native tool calling in Ollama). A 3-case rerun on 2026-10-18 gave the same verdicts, tool calls and final states (reply wording differed). Hosted Gemma 4: see the Gemini API entry.

integrations.name: Mastra agent
integrations.note: examples/mastra-agent (@mastra/core 1.78.0) full suite on local qwen3:8b: 6 pass / 6 fail / 0 error. A 2-case rerun on 2026-10-18 gave the same verdicts and tool calls.

integrations.name: Temporal durable evaluation runs
integrations.note: Local Temporal dev server (CLI 1.9.1, Server 1.32.0): same summary as bolibench run; after kill -9 of the worker the interrupted case ran again (attempt 2) and the run completed; restarting the same workflow id re-ran nothing. The agent in the crash test was a slow stub. This makes the evaluation run durable, not the agent. Not run on Temporal Cloud.

integrations.name: MongoDB export (Atlas pending)
integrations.note: Exported 3 bundled runs into a local MongoDB 7.0.45: idempotent re-export, indexes, per-case report, live test passing. Not yet run against an Atlas cluster: needs a dedicated Atlas cluster or user created by the owner.

integrations.name: Tiger Data export + similar-failure search (Tiger Cloud pending)
integrations.note: Local TimescaleDB 2.30.2 + pgvector 0.8.7 (PostgreSQL 16): hypertable export, idempotent, report, 22 failures embedded with local embeddinggemma, hybrid keyword + vector search. Not yet run on Tiger Cloud: needs a dedicated service created by the owner.

integrations.name: Sentry agent tracing
integrations.note: Implemented and tested offline only: gen_ai agent, chat and tool spans checked with the real sentry-sdk and an in-memory transport; error events carry no local variables (so no API key or utterance), and model/tool exceptions are captured. No trace has been sent to Sentry: a dedicated BoliBench DSN is still needed.

integrations.name: DigitalOcean serverless inference
integrations.note: Blocked: no DigitalOcean model access key exists. Request format checked against DigitalOcean's docs and a local stub; never called.

integrations.name: DigitalOcean App Platform deploy
integrations.note: Blocked: no DigitalOcean credentials. Same Docker image as Render; the spec was checked by hand against the App Spec reference, not with doctl. Not deployed.
